text:
Ivy L: FYI AuroraStack asked to onboard Atlantic-2 (atl2) as a hybrid marketplace + SI-managed region. They want a mixed dedicated/burst pool and a short joint-announcement window. Need to coordinate marketplace SKU, quotas, SI integration (VectorOps), and KMS model.

Marcus G: can we get numbers and whether they need pinned hosts or autoscaling pools? Also any press timeline?

Omar (AuroraStack): Thanks Ivy. High level: we need a dedicated baseline + burst instances for cost scaling. Target launch 2025-05-15 for joint announcement (soft). POC is Omar.

Omar (AuroraStack): quotas below:
```
Requested quotas (atl2):
- Dedicated GPU pool: 8 x H100-80GB (pinned hosts)
- Burst GPU pool: 16 x T4 (preemptible-like)
- vCPU: 1024
- RAM: 6TB
- Block storage: 120TB
- Floating IPs: 16
Marketplace SKU: aurorastack.atl2.hybrid
Entitlement tag: aurora-onboard-2025
Smoke tests: 1 x H100, 2 x T4 for integration
Joint announcement target: 2025-05-15 (hold until legal + infra green)
```

Nina Q: VectorOps integration is part of the plan? Evan, what do you need from our side (endpoints, service accounts, tokens)?

Evan (VectorOps): We need a service account with role: "inference-runner", a webhook endpoint for job callbacks, and an encrypted secret for our CI to pull the smoke-test container. Also, we prefer partner-managed KMS for key lifecycle control due to our SOC requirements.

Ivy L: Noted. Redwood's default is Redwood-managed KMS for marketplace SKUs. If partner requires partner-managed keys, we need a security review + documentation of key escrow and rotation. Priya, can legal/ security weigh in?

Priya R: Legal: we need to confirm data residency and PII handling. Also need to review the joint announcement language and a short SLA addendum. If AuroraStack insists on partner-managed KMS, we need an ATO checklist and a liability carveout. I can fast-track the announcement copy if infra says no blockers.

Marcus G: Infra questions: peering ASN + colocator POP? Also need to know if burst T4s will be billed differently and whether autoscaler will be in front of the burst pool.

Omar (AuroraStack): Colocator POP: LIN-BX1 (Barcelona edge). ASN: 65012. Burst pool will be autoscaled by VectorOps controller, AuroraStack will cover burst egress. For billing: dedicated pool invoiced as committed capacity, burst billed on usage.

Evan (VectorOps): We'll deploy our autoscaler operator; need RBAC and a short-lived service account token to register. We can use webhook for placement events.

Ivy L: I created a checklist in-thread:
- Quota/entitlement request: Marcus G
- SI integration (service accounts/webhooks): Evan / Nina Q
- KMS model decision & security review: Security + Priya R
- Marketplace listing & press draft: Marketing (cc Nina)
- Legal & announcement review: Priya R
- Smoke-test + CI artifacts: Omar / Evan

ops-bot: Jira created INC-9022 "aurorastack atl2 hybrid marketplace + SI integration" - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-9022

Marcus G: I'll file the cloud quota request today. ETA for smoke soft quota (1H100 + 2T4) ~72h. Full quota depends on security/KMS decision.

Nina Q: I'll start the marketplace draft and tag marketing for the announcement language. Can someone confirm if we can use partner logo on day 1? Need brand assets.

Omar (AuroraStack): We can provide logos and a 1-paragraph co-announcement. Fine to hold release until legal signs off.

Priya R: I'll draft a short joint announcement clause and the KMS contract addendum. Expect initial comments in 48h.

Evan (VectorOps): I'll send the RBAC spec and webhook schema to the Jira ticket. Also will request a short-lived token during staging.

Ivy L: Action items: Marcus files quota, Priya + Security review KMS option, Nina pulls marketing assets, Evan + Aurora upload integration artifacts to INC-9022. We'll sync next Tues for go/no-go.

Marcus G: starting quota request now.

Omar (AuroraStack): uploading smoke test container `aurora/atl2-smoke:v1` to the ticket.

Nina Q: copied marketing. Will prepare teaser and embargo notes.

Priya R: will coordinate security on the KMS ATO.

Ivy L: Thanks everyone — please add any blockers to INC-9022. :rocket:
